basis: The task requires routing the year with the highest per-barrel cost. The chart title explicitly defines the metric as 'Price in U.S. dollars per barrel'. The y-axis is inverted, with 0 at the top and 35 at the bottom, meaning marks positioned lower on the page correspond to higher numeric values. Visual inspection confirms the 1980 marker is the lowest point on the page, situated below the 35 grid line, indicating it has the highest value on the scale (approximately $38-40). In contrast, the 1976 marker is near the top (low value) and the 1986 marker is in the middle range. Therefore, 1980 represents the highest cost.
